MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxy feels useful for small repairs alongside my recent fastening and mounting supplies, so I would try it.",
    "The weather-resistant duct tape fits outdoor repair work suggested by my deck screws, making it a plausible next purchase."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors, heat shrink tubing, and electronic cleaner assume electrical work that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "Locking nuts and hose clamps serve different fastening needs from my wood screws, framing nails, and drywall anchors; their usefulness depends on a project I have not indicated.",
    "The cutting wheels require a compatible tool and a metal-cutting task, while the caliper addresses precision measurement I do not currently need.",
    "Buying medicine cups does not establish a need for a COVID test, just as buying vacuum bags does not establish a need for electronic cleaner."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat many repair supplies as interchangeable, even when they serve very different tasks.",
    "Shared words such as waterproof or fastening are not enough to make specialized wiring or mechanical supplies relevant to my current work."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors point most strongly toward construction, mounting, and wood fastening.",
    "Specific compatibility matters: nail angle, screw dimensions, intended material, and tool requirements determine whether I can actually use a supply.",
    "My occasional medicine cups and vacuum bags represent separate needs and should not outweigh the repeated fastening purchases."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my repair needs but stretched them into electrical, mechanical, and medical tasks I have not indicated."
}
